messages:
jesse (sales): Hey team — prepping a 72h pilot for a prospect (Oxford MedTech). They want sustained low-latency inference in eu-west1 for a live triage demo. Expected sustained throughput ~25 qps with ~600 tokens per request during demo windows. Asking if we can grant a temporary capacity exception (admission + quota) and a short dedicated warm pool? They indicated: fast yes = contract. Need answer today. TLDR: 72h exception + warm pool in eu-west1.

priya (support): Thanks — can you confirm peak concurrent connections and whether they will use hosted or private? Also need the org/project id so we can open a ticket with billing/capacity.

jesse (sales): They'll use hosted. Org: oxford-medtech-prod. Peak concurrent ~120 connections, sustained ~25 qps, short bursts up to ~60 qps.

ken (eng-sre): @priya @jesse heads-up: admission control + queueing in eu-west1 is currently running close to 95% during peak. A temporary override is possible but we need exact window and SLA expectations. For 25 qps @600 tokens that's ~15k tokens/s (~1.2M tokens/min). Suggest provisioning a warm pool of 4 A100-equivalent instances for the 72h window. Also recommend pre-warming KV caches and pinning the model version. We can also enforce per-route throttles to protect production traffic.

lia (solutions): Quick security note — they mentioned HIPAA. If that's true, hosted with BAA might work but Dedicated is faster from compliance perspective. Sales, confirm HIPAA vs non-HIPAA.

capacity-bot: Current eu-west1 GPU availability: 6/8 pools free. Admission-control throttle at 92% for open pools. Average queue latency 140ms and trending up.

priya (support): Opening internal ticket T-5721. Jesse — please include a short written commitment from the customer (they said they'd sign reserved capacity if pilot meets latency). Also attach NDA/LOI.

jesse (sales): Confirmed — they will sign a 6-month reserved capacity if pilot succeeds. Attaching LOI and NDA to the ticket now.

ken (eng-sre): Two immediate actions from eng-sre: 1) temporary quota bump + warm pool (4 units) for the exact 72h window, 2) pre-warm KV caches and pin model revision. Also implement graceful fallback: route to quantized variant when queue latency > 200ms. I can pre-stage images now.

priya (support): How quickly can ops-capacity approve? Customer wants greenlight today.

ken (eng-sre): I can approve from eng-sre in ~2 hours if legal signs off. I will pre-stage and set rollback policy.

lia (solutions): If HIPAA is required, recommend Dedicated. Please loop in legal and security.

jesse (sales): Looping legal now. Proposed window: 2026-03-20 08:00 UTC -> 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC.

capacity-bot: Provision request recorded: req-oxf-1813456789. Estimated incremental cost for 72h warm pool (4 A100-eq): ~$18,400. Alerting rule created: route to eng-sre on queue latency > 200ms.

ken (eng-sre): Approved from my side pending legal. @priya escalate to ops-capacity for final sign-off and billing confirmation.

priya (support): Escalated to ops-capacity, ticket updated with org/id/LOI/commitment and HIPAA flag. Will update here as soon as ops-capacity confirms.

jesse (sales): Quick note for ops/capacity: demo will hit the /v1/generate chat route. Example demo header to expect:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.example/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" 
 -H "X-Org-ID: oxford-medtech-prod" 
 -d '{"model":"triage-1", "inputs": "..."}'
```
This is for routing & tagging only.

ken (eng-sre): I'll also add a temporary admission rule to prioritize this org's tokens during the window, with a soft cap fallback to compat-quantized model to keep p99 latency under control.

priya (support): Ops-capacity replied in the ticket, they asked for expected token burn/day and the legal greenlight. Jesse — can you paste tokens/day estimate?

jesse (sales): Estimated token burn: ~1.8M tokens/hour peak -> ~43.2M tokens/day during demo periods.

capacity-bot: Ops-capacity queue: pending approval. Current approver list: ops-capacity, finance.

ken (eng-sre): I'll monitor pre-warm results and stand by for rollback. If approved, we should schedule a 30-min dry-run before the demo start.

priya (support): Great. Ticket T-5721 updated with dry-run request. Will circle back after ops-capacity decision. :thumbsup:
